title: Dynamic bigraphical Mat\'ern--Whittle processes: learning dependence graphs among spatial-temporal fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.18454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many studies record several variables at the same sites over a sequence of periods, such as pollutant concentrations at monitoring stations or case counts of infectious diseases by district. A central question concerns the dependence between the variables and its change over time. We develop dynamic bigraphical Mat\'ern--Whittle (DBMW) processes for such data. Each variable has a spatial field that evolves by autoregression. A graph over the variables couples the temporal innovations of the fields. Its links appear and vanish over time, and a link may change sign. A graph Laplacian on the sites gives the spatial structure, and a canonical exponential family links the fields to Gaussian, count or binomial responses. The joint distribution of the latent fields over all sites, variables and periods factorizes over the eigenmodes of the graph Laplacian, and its normalizing constant is free of the graph and of the dynamics. translated_title: 动态双图Matérn–Whittle过程：学习时空场之间的依赖图
translated_abstract: 许多研究在相同的地点上跨多个时期记录多个变量，例如监测站的污染物浓度或按区域统计的传染病病例数。一个核心问题是变量之间的依赖关系及其随时间的变化。我们为此类数据开发了动态双图Matérn–Whittle（DBMW）过程。每个变量都有一个通过自回归演化的空间场。变量上的一个图将各场的时间新息耦合起来，其连边随时间出现和消失，且一条连边可能改变符号。地点上的图拉普拉斯算子给出空间结构，规范指数族将场与高斯、计数或二项响应联系起来。潜在场在所有地点、变量和时期上的联合分布在图拉普拉斯算子的特征模态上可分解，其归一化常数与图和动态无关。给定潜在场后……
tldr: 该论文提出动态双图Matérn–Whittle（DBMW）过程，能够学习多变量时空场之间随时间变化（连边出现、消失甚至改变符号）的依赖图结构，同时支持高斯、计数和二项等多种响应类型，且联合分布可借助图拉普拉斯特征模态高效分解计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dynamic bigraphical Matérn–Whittle (DBMW) processes that learn time-varying dependence graphs among multivariate spatial-temporal fields—with links appearing, vanishing, and changing sign—while supporting Gaussian, count, and binomial responses via a joint distribution that factorizes efficiently over graph Laplacian eigenmodes.
